newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian defence minister seeks more cash for army.
newsitem.headline: Russian defence minister seeks more cash for army.

text.p: Russian Defence Minister Igor Rodionov appealed to President Boris Yeltsin on Tuesday for extra money to ease a crisis in the army, where he said the situation was becoming unbearable.

Rodionov has played down any talk of a rebellion in the armed forces, but he told a news conference that a lack of funding could lead to uncontrollable processes which could weaken Russia's combat readiness.
"I appeal to society, the president, the government and parliament. We must find a way out," Rodionov said. "The situation is becoming unbearable."
The army, the pride of Soviet society, has suffered from underfunding and low morale since the superpower fell apart, and many soldiers have not been paid for months.
Security chief Alexander Lebed, who backed Rodionov as Russian defence minister, said last week that the army was close to mutiny because of frustration at government negligence and unpaid wages.
Rodionov said at the time that the situation was under control.
